pkgmetadata.longdescription: Web fetch, search, and crawl tool for AI agents. A single Rust binary with a custom stealthy HTTP/2 transport driven by Chrome's BoringSSL, keyless parallel search backends, PDF extraction, and optional OCR/reranking. The ocr and rerank upstream features are not exposed as USE flags.

use.flag: Build the MCP HTTP server (axum) for the --http flag
